newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends shade down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends shade down on profit-taking.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended a shade lower on Wednesday from New York's previous close on some producer selling and profit-taking during an otherwise very quiet day, bullion dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$349.20/70 an ounce against New York's US$349.25/75 close on Tuesday.
Dealers noted producer sales and some reported profit-taking but most said gold had remained quiet through the day.
Punters were standing aside to watch for fallout from stock market movements, some traders said.
U.S. producer prices, ex-food and energy, are to be released at 1230 GMT.
Local gold ended HK$14 higher at HK$3,226 a tael.
Spot gold would continue to range between $347 and $350, trapped by buying at the lower end and selling at the upper end, traders said.
Physical buying interest below $347 per ounce remained.
